title: snippets/<id>.md header
description: A single snippet's header. The JSON object between the --- lines only; the body is outside this schema. The body is its text, a template.

label.description: The display name of the snippet; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the snippet).

if.description: A JSON Logic condition for whether the snippet's text is placed, or null for always.

format.description: The text format of the body: plaintext, markdown_block or markdown_inline.
